from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import binary_dilation, gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src = np.load(CASE / 'source_pixels.npz')['rgb']
assert src.shape == (96,144,256,3) and src.dtype == np.uint8

# The camera and environment are static.  A temporal median is therefore an
# exact clean plate wherever the moving dice do not spend most of the clip.
# For the final white-die position, use the first frame: that patch is clean at
# t=0 (the die starts high above it).  This also reconstructs the thin sigil
# lines rather than painting a flat approximation.
plate = np.median(src, axis=0).astype(np.uint8)
yy, xx = np.mgrid[:144,:256]
final_patch = (xx >= 120) & (xx <= 145) & (yy >= 69) & (yy <= 99)
plate[final_patch] = src[0][final_patch]

# Hand-tracked white-die centres.  The first 28 values follow its ballistic
# descent/bounces; from frame 29 it rests at the same location.  Boxes include
# the complete cube silhouette plus its soft contact/cast shadow.  A compact
# feather is used only on the outermost ring, preserving the sharp background.
centres = np.array([
 (132,12),(132,13),(132,20),(132,29),(132,39),(132,51),(132,64),
 (133,78),(133,72),(132,67),(132,64),(132,61),(132,60),(132,62),
 (132,65),(132,69),(132,75),(132,76),(132,74),(132,73),(132,74),
 (132,77),(132,79),(132,77),(132,77),(132,79),(132,79),(132,79)
], dtype=float)

out = src.copy()
for i in range(96):
    cx, cy = centres[min(i, len(centres)-1)]
    # Cube is about 15x16 px. Its shadow extends down/right, especially aloft.
    dx = xx-cx; dy = yy-cy
    cube = (np.abs(dx) <= 9.0) & (np.abs(dy) <= 10.0)
    # At the top border use a broad region because frame 1 contains a clipped
    # cube; elsewhere this follows the visible cube and anti-aliased outline.
    if i == 0:
        cube |= (xx>=122)&(xx<=142)&(yy<=29)
    # Soft shadow: airborne shadow lies on the mat near y~88, while close to
    # landing it sits directly beneath/right of the die.
    if cy < 68:
        sy = 88.0
        sx = 133.0
        shadow = ((xx-sx)/10.0)**2 + ((yy-sy)/5.0)**2 <= 1
    else:

artifact_io.save(out, CASE)

 (133,78),(133,72),(132,67),(132,64),(132,61),(132,60),(132,62),
 (132,65),(132,69),(132,75),(132,76),(132,74),(132,73),(132,74),
 (132,77),(132,79),(132,77),(132,77),(132,79),(132,79),(132,79)
], dtype=float)

out = src.copy()
for i in range(96):
    cx, cy = centres[min(i, len(centres)-1)]
    # Cube is about 15x16 px. Its shadow extends down/right, especially aloft.
    dx = xx-cx; dy = yy-cy
    cube = (np.abs(dx) <= 9.0) & (np.abs(dy) <= 10.0)
    # At the top border use a broad region because frame 1 contains a clipped
    # cube; elsewhere this follows the visible cube and anti-aliased outline.
    if i == 0:
        cube |= (xx>=122)&(xx<=142)&(yy<=29)
    # Soft shadow: airborne shadow lies on the mat near y~88, while close to
    # landing it sits directly beneath/right of the die.
    if cy < 68:
        sy = 88.0
        sx = 133.0
        shadow = ((xx-sx)/10.0)**2 + ((yy-sy)/5.0)**2 <= 1
    else:
        shadow = ((xx-(cx+2))/10.0)**2 + ((yy-(cy+9))/5.0)**2 <= 1
    core = cube | shadow
    # Two-pixel transition catches antialiasing and blurred shadow tails.
    outer = binary_dilation(core, iterations=2)
    alpha = gaussian_filter(core.astype(float), 0.75)
    alpha = np.where(outer, np.maximum(alpha, 0.22), 0.0)
    alpha = alpha[...,None]
    out[i] = np.rint(out[i]*(1-alpha) + plate*alpha).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8)

    # The red die passes in front of the white die. Re-composite its visible
    # silhouette after repairing the background, so the intended removal never
    # nicks its antialiased outline or black pips at the overlap. Red face pixels
    # seed the silhouette; hole filling includes pips, and a small dilation
    # includes the dark outline and antialiasing without restoring the white die.
    r, g, b = src[i].transpose(2,0,1)
    red = (r > 120) & (r.astype(int)-g > 28) & (r.astype(int)-b > 20)
    red[:, :110] = False
    red[:, 133:] = False
    red[105:] = False
    labs, count = label(red)
    sizes = np.bincount(labs.ravel())
    keep = sizes >= 4
    keep[0] = False
    red_core = binary_fill_holes(keep[labs])
    expanded = binary_dilation(red_core, iterations=2)
    chroma_or_dark = (((r.astype(int)-g > 20) &
                       (r.astype(int)-b > 15)) |
                      (src[i].mean(2) < 100))
    red = expanded & chroma_or_dark

    # white die's shadow is farther right, so this small region is unambiguous.

    darker = src[i].mean(2) < plate.mean(2) - 3
    restore_shadow = red_shadow_zone & darker
    out[i][restore_shadow] = src[i][restore_shadow]

"""Output-only helpers. No drawing or generation policy is implemented here."""
from pathlib import Path
import base64
import json
import wave

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw


def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from scipy.ndimage import binary_dilation, gaussian_filter
import artifact_io

CASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
src = np.load(CASE / 'source_pixels.npz')['rgb']
assert src.shape == (96,144,256,3) and src.dtype == np.uint8

# The camera and environment are static.  A temporal median is therefore an
# exact clean plate wherever the moving dice do not spend most of the clip.
# For the final white-die position, use the first frame: that patch is clean at
# t=0 (the die starts high above it).  This also reconstructs the thin sigil
# lines rather than painting a flat approximation.
plate = np.median(src, axis=0).astype(np.uint8)
yy, xx = np.mgrid[:144,:256]
final_patch = (xx >= 120) & (xx <= 145) & (yy >= 69) & (yy <= 99)
plate[final_patch] = src[0][final_patch]

# Hand-tracked white-die centres.  The first 28 values follow its ballistic
# descent/bounces; from frame 29 it rests at the same location.  Boxes include
# the complete cube silhouette plus its soft contact/cast shadow.  A compact
# feather is used only on the outermost ring, preserving the sharp background.
centres = np.array([
 (132,12),(132,13),(132,20),(132,29),(132,39),(132,51),(132,64),
 (133,78),(133,72),(132,67),(132,64),(132,61),(132,60),(132,62),
 (132,65),(132,69),(132,75),(132,76),(132,74),(132,73),(132,74),
 (132,77),(132,79),(132,77),(132,77),(132,79),(132,79),(132,79)
], dtype=float)

out = src.copy()
for i in range(96):
    cx, cy = centres[min(i, len(centres)-1)]
    # Cube is about 15x16 px. Its shadow extends down/right, especially aloft.
    dx = xx-cx; dy = yy-cy
    cube = (np.abs(dx) <= 9.0) & (np.abs(dy) <= 10.0)
    # At the top border use a broad region because frame 1 contains a clipped
    # cube; elsewhere this follows the visible cube and anti-aliased outline.
    if i == 0:
        cube |= (xx>=122)&(xx<=142)&(yy<=29)
    # Soft shadow: airborne shadow lies on the mat near y~88, while close to
    # landing it sits directly beneath/right of the die.
    if cy < 68:
        sy = 88.0
        sx = 133.0
        shadow = ((xx-sx)/10.0)**2 + ((yy-sy)/5.0)**2 <= 1
    else:
        shadow = ((xx-(cx+2))/10.0)**2 + ((yy-(cy+9))/5.0)**2 <= 1
    core = cube | shadow
    # Two-pixel transition catches antialiasing and blurred shadow tails.
    outer = binary_dilation(core, iterations=2)
    alpha = gaussian_filter(core.astype(float), 0.75)
    alpha = np.where(outer, np.maximum(alpha, 0.22), 0.0)
    alpha = alpha[...,None]
    out[i] = np.rint(out[i]*(1-alpha) + plate*alpha).clip(0,255).astype(np.uint8)

artifact_io.save(out, CASE)
